comment: SCHEME CONTRACT. A hyperlink is not a code dependency. Decoding runs BEFORE the scheme test, which is the whole point of lines 20-21: `javascript:` and `javascript:` are the same string to an HTML parser as `javascript:`, and the pre-fix bare `startsWith` filter missed both AND existed only in the <a> branch — so `<form action="javascript:…">` emitted a `calls` edge and an `imports` row for one. A form endpoint is a dependency on a backend route and is NOT a call: `Calls` claims "this symbol invokes that symbol", which is false for a URL.  LINE NOTE: the four line-pinned navigation/form expectations below were re-measured after a 10-line block (the `href="#"` / empty-href / real-hash cases) was added above them; each moved down by exactly 11 lines (10 inserted + 1 blank separator). HONESTY §4.1, pinned on the 0.9 tier. Every relationship below 1.0 must carry a MACHINE-READABLE reason code, and this tier's only justification was a comment in the analyzer's source. Measured over the corpus (1,186 git-tracked documents / 25 repositories): 60,285 html-native edges sat at this tier — 59,953 `navigation` and 332 `form-action` — and 0 of them carried a field a consumer or an audit could read. The five rows pinned here are one of each kind, so a regression that drops the field fails a pin rather than nothing. The tier is not a defect: an observed hyperlink is not a derived fact, and the code says so in a place `bb_graph` can filter on.

expectRelationships.comment: In-project navigation is a real dependency and stays, at 0.9 — an observed link is not a derived fact.
A form endpoint is a dependency and is NOT a `calls` edge.
All five javascript: spellings are recognised, including both entity-obfuscated forms.
An unrecognised reference, a reference missing its semicolon, and a bare ampersand all survive VERBATIM — dropping half a URL would silently invent a different resource.
A bare `#` and an empty href are 'no destination' and emit nothing; a real path is a dependency.

forbidRelationships.comment: Cross-origin and non-resource schemes are counted, never graphed.
The full javascript: URL is never a target — only the recognisable scheme marker is, so the payload is not a second copy of the source text.
formaction is a form endpoint only on a submitting control.

Target-only twins of the five cross-origin forbids above: the pre-fix state attributed an unowned `<a href>` to the DOCUMENT, so a forbid that names the element as `from` cannot see it. A fabrication is caught by the TARGET, whatever claims to be its source.

`href="#"` is the top of THIS document. An edge to the literal `#` is a node that is neither a symbol nor a file — the unresolvable-identity class, reintroduced by the rewrite and caught only by hand-auditing the M12 Negative fixture's documented contract against live output.
